spec2def(ncrypt.dll ncrypt.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB NO_PRIVATE_WARNINGS)

# ncrypt.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ncrypt-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(ncrypt_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(ncrypt_shims PRIVATE wine symcrypt oldnames libbcrypt libmsvcrt libadvapi32 libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
set_wine_module(ncrypt_shims)
add_cargo_module(ncrypt ncrypt-cargo ncrypt.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ncrypt_shims psdk)
